sql:
SELECT s.mailstreet, s.school
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.avgscrmath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS max_free_meal_rate_ages_5_17
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.numtsttakr > 0
  AND CAST(s.numge1500 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.numtsttakr > 0.3

SELECT s.school, s.doctype
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
      SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON f2.cdscode = s2.cdscode
      WHERE s2.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "doctype" = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "doctype" = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM "schools"
WHERE "statustype" = 'Merged'
  AND "county" = 'Orange'

SELECT ROUND(CAST(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS numeric), 6) AS "Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)"
FROM "frpm" f
JOIN "schools" s ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."soc" = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
  AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.18

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
       f."District Code"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."admfname1" = 'Alusine'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s."numtsttakr", 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM "schools" sc
LEFT JOIN "satscores" s
    ON s."cds" = sc."cdscode"
WHERE sc."charternum" = '756'
  AND sc."mailcity" = 'San Diego'

SELECT
    "School Name",
    "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) * 100 AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9'

WITH target_schools AS (
    SELECT '01751010130583' AS cds
    UNION ALL SELECT '01612910137588'
    UNION ALL SELECT '01611760134270'
),
enrollment AS (
    SELECT s.ncesschool, f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enr
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE f.cdscode IN (SELECT cds FROM target_schools)
)
SELECT e.ncesschool
FROM enrollment e
WHERE e.enr = (SELECT MAX(enr) FROM enrollment)

SELECT admemail1 AS email
FROM schools
WHERE soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
  AND doctype = 'Unified School District'
  AND city = 'San Bernardino'
  AND county = 'San Bernardino'
  AND opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND admemail1 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT admemail2 AS email
FROM schools
WHERE soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
  AND doctype = 'Unified School District'
  AND city = 'San Bernardino'
  AND county = 'San Bernardino'
  AND opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND admemail2 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT admemail3 AS email
FROM schools
WHERE soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
  AND doctype = 'Unified School District'
  AND city = 'San Bernardino'
  AND county = 'San Bernardino'
  AND opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND admemail3 IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = '1611920113902'
  AND s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND s.county = 'Alameda'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'

SELECT s.school AS school_name,
       s.mailstreet AS mailing_street_address
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.doctype = 'State Board of Education'
  AND sat.rtype = 'S'
  AND sat.avgscrread = (
      SELECT MAX(sat2.avgscrread)
      FROM satscores sat2
      JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.cdscode
      WHERE s2.doctype = 'State Board of Education'
        AND sat2.rtype = 'S'
  )

WITH hs AS (
    SELECT
        s.school,
        s.gsserved,
        split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1) AS low_g,
        split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 2) AS high_g
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.ncesdist = '0613360'
      AND s.statustype = 'Active'
      AND split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 2) = '12'
      AND COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0) = 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        school,
        gsserved,
        CASE
            WHEN low_g = 'PK' THEN -1
            WHEN low_g = 'K' THEN 0
            WHEN low_g ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN low_g::int
            ELSE NULL
        END AS start_rank
    FROM hs
)
SELECT school, gsserved
FROM ranked
WHERE start_rank = (SELECT MIN(start_rank) FROM ranked)
ORDER BY school

SELECT s."avgscrmath", s."numtsttakr"
FROM "satscores" s
JOIN "schools" sc ON s."cds" = sc."cdscode"
WHERE s."cds" = '1611190130609'
  AND sc."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded'

SELECT s.school, s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND (CASE WHEN f."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) END) > 9
ORDER BY s.school

WITH sb_schools AS (
    SELECT s."school", s."phone", sat."numge1500"
    FROM "schools" s
    JOIN "satscores" sat ON sat."cds" = s."cdscode"
    WHERE s."doctype" = 'Statewide Benefit Charters'
)
SELECT "school", "phone"
FROM sb_schools
WHERE "numge1500" = (SELECT MAX("numge1500") FROM sb_schools)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
  AND rtype = 'S'
  AND numtsttakr > (
      SELECT numtsttakr
      FROM satscores
      WHERE cds = '7618040730051'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat
  ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE s.mailcity = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.doctype IN (
        'Unified School District',
        'High School District',
        'Elementary School District',
        'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
  AND (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) >= 1500

SELECT "school", "eilname"
FROM "schools"
WHERE "cdscode" = '1612590136051'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0))::numeric / COUNT(s.cdscode), 2) AS average_frpm_count_ages_5_17
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
 AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.soctype ILIKE '%Youth Authority%'

WITH district_starts AS (
    SELECT split_part("gsoffered", '-', 1) AS lowest_grade
    FROM "schools"
    WHERE "ncesdist" = '0632640'
      AND "gsoffered" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT lowest_grade
FROM district_starts
WHERE lowest_grade IN ('P', 'PS', 'K')
   OR lowest_grade ~ '^[0-9]+$'
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN lowest_grade IN ('P', 'PS') THEN 0
           WHEN lowest_grade = 'K' THEN 1
           ELSE CAST(lowest_grade AS INTEGER) + 1
         END
LIMIT 1

WITH sbe_schools AS (
    SELECT s.school, s.admemail1, sat.numge1500
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.doctype = 'State Board of Education'
)
SELECT school, admemail1
FROM sbe_schools
WHERE numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM sbe_schools)

WITH admins AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.cdscode, s.district, v.fn
    FROM schools s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (s.admfname1), (s.admfname2), (s.admfname3)) AS v(fn)
    WHERE s.county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND s.doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                        'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
      AND v.fn IS NOT NULL
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT fn
    FROM admins
    GROUP BY fn
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, fn ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
)
SELECT d.district AS "District Name",
       t.fn AS "First Name",
       COUNT(a.cdscode) AS "School Count"
FROM districts d
CROSS JOIN top_names t
LEFT JOIN admins a
       ON a.district = d.district
      AND a.fn = t.fn
GROUP BY d.district, t.fn
ORDER BY d.district, t.fn

WITH middle AS (
    SELECT "soctype", "school", "latitude"
    FROM schools
    WHERE ("soctype" ILIKE '%middle%' OR "soctype" ILIKE '%junior%'
           OR "school" ILIKE '%middle%' OR "school" ILIKE '%junior%')
      AND "latitude" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "soctype" AS "School Type", "school" AS "School Name", "latitude"
FROM middle
WHERE "latitude" = (SELECT MAX("latitude") FROM middle)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM schools sc
LEFT JOIN satscores s
    ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND sc.opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01'
  AND sc.opendate < DATE '2008-01-01'
  AND sc.doctype IN (
        'Unified School District',
        'Elementary School District',
        'High School District',
        'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )

SELECT
    f."School Name",
    f."Low Grade",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0) AS num_sat_test_takers
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools sc ON sc.cdscode = f.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE sc.doc = '31'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN -1
        WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER)
    END DESC,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC,
    f."School Name" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."school" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s."school") <> ''
  AND RIGHT(s."cdscode", 7) <> '0000000'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 8
  AND COALESCE(sat."numtsttakr", 0) = 0

WITH closed_sat AS (
    SELECT s."school" AS school_name,
           s."district" AS district_name,
           s."county" AS county_name,
           sat."avgscrwrite" AS avg_writing
    FROM "satscores" sat
    JOIN "schools" s ON sat."cds" = s."cdscode"
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
      AND sat."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
),
second_best AS (
    SELECT MAX(avg_writing) AS sc
    FROM closed_sat
    WHERE avg_writing < (SELECT MAX(avg_writing) FROM closed_sat)
)
SELECT c.school_name, c.district_name, c.county_name, c.avg_writing
FROM closed_sat c
JOIN second_best sb ON c.avg_writing = sb.sc

SELECT
    s.fundingtype AS funding_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment_k12,
    ROUND((AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") * 100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite)::numeric, 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
    ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.eilname = 'High School'
  AND COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

SELECT
    s.fundingtype AS "Charter Funding Type",
    COUNT(*) AS "Number of Schools",
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "Total K-12 Enrollment",
    SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS "Total FRPM-Eligible K-12 Students"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.charter = 1
  AND s.doctype = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.fundingtype = 'Directly funded' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS avg_schools_per_month
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'San Diego'
  AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01'
  AND doctype IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District')

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s."virtual" IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM "satscores" sat
JOIN "schools" s ON sat."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE sat."avgscrmath" > 400

SELECT s.school AS school_name,
       s.county,
       s.district,
       s.city,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)",
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
       sat.numtsttakr,
       sat.avgscrread,
       sat.avgscrmath,
       sat.avgscrwrite,
       sat.numge1500
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = '1612590137943'

SELECT
    sc.school AS school_name,
    sc.phone,
    sc.website,
    s.avgscrread AS avg_sat_reading,
    s.avgscrmath AS avg_sat_math,
    s.avgscrwrite AS avg_sat_writing,
    CASE WHEN sc.charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS charter_school,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND((f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pct_frpm_eligible,
    m.max_avg_math - s.avgscrmath AS math_gap_from_highest
FROM schools sc
LEFT JOIN satscores s
    ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.cdscode = sc.cdscode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(s2.avgscrmath) AS max_avg_math
    FROM satscores s2
    JOIN schools sc2 ON sc2.cdscode = s2.cds
    WHERE sc2.statustype = 'Active'
      AND s2.numtsttakr >= 10
) m
WHERE sc.cdscode = '7618040113118'

WITH county AS (
    SELECT "County Name" AS county_name
    FROM frpm
    WHERE cdscode = '1612590125716'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        f.cdscode,
        f."County Name",
        f."Charter School (Y/N)",
        ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::numeric / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)"::numeric, 0)) * 100, 2) AS free_pct,
        ROUND((f."FRPM Count (K-12)"::numeric / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)"::numeric, 0)) * 100, 2) AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN county c ON f."County Name" = c.county_name
    WHERE f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
)
SELECT
    b."County Name" AS county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(b.free_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(b.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite)::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = b.cdscode
GROUP BY b."County Name"

WITH target AS (
    SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS county
    UNION
    SELECT county FROM schools WHERE cdscode = '01100170109835'
)
SELECT t.county,
       COUNT(s.cdscode) AS num_exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM target t
LEFT JOIN schools s
       ON s.county = t.county
      AND s.virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY t.county
ORDER BY num_exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, t.county ASC

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s."school" AS school_name,
        s."gsserved" AS grades_served,
        s."charter" AS charter_flag,
        f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate,
        sat."avgscrread" + sat."avgscrmath" + sat."avgscrwrite" AS sat_total,
        sat."avgscrread" AS r,
        sat."avgscrmath" AS m,
        sat."avgscrwrite" AS w
    FROM "schools" s
    JOIN "frpm" f ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
    LEFT JOIN "satscores" sat ON sat."cds" = s."cdscode"
    WHERE s."county" = 'Alameda'
      AND s."gsserved" LIKE '%12'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    ROUND(free_meal_rate::numeric, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN charter_flag = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN charter_flag = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN r IS NULL OR m IS NULL OR w IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM base
WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM base)

WITH virt AS (
    SELECT s.cdscode, s.county, s.school
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM virt
    GROUP BY county
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT county, cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT county, cnt,
               DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rnk
        FROM county_counts
    ) x
    WHERE rnk <= 5
),
school_scores AS (
    SELECT v.county, v.school, sat.avgscrread
    FROM virt v
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = v.cdscode
    WHERE sat.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
),
best AS (
    SELECT county, school
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.county, ss.school,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.county ORDER BY ss.avgscrread DESC) AS rk
        FROM school_scores ss
    ) y
    WHERE rk = 1
)
SELECT tc.county,
       tc.cnt,
       COALESCE(b.school, 'None') AS school
FROM top_counties tc
LEFT JOIN best b ON b.county = tc.county
ORDER BY tc.cnt DESC, tc.county, school

SELECT s.school, s.street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND s.school IS NOT NULL
  AND s.school <> ''
  AND (
        f."High Grade" = 'K'
        OR (f."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 8)
      )

SELECT s."school", s."street"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30
  AND (CASE WHEN f."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER)
       END) >= 9
ORDER BY s."cdscode"

SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE s.county = (SELECT county FROM schools WHERE cdscode = '1611430131177')
  AND sat.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY sat.numge1500 DESC NULLS LAST, sat.cds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.numtsttakr >= 700
ORDER BY (sat.numge1500 * 1.0 / sat.numtsttakr) ASC, sat.cds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT f."County Name" AS county_name,
       COUNT(*) AS num_qualifying_schools
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND f."County Name" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND s.numge1500 >= 1
GROUP BY f."County Name"
ORDER BY num_qualifying_schools DESC, county_name ASC

SELECT "id"
FROM "cards"
WHERE "bordercolor" = 'borderless'
  AND (
        "cardkingdomid" IS NULL OR "cardkingdomid" = ''
     OR "cardkingdomfoilid" IS NULL OR "cardkingdomfoilid" = ''
      )

WITH ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.ispromo, COUNT(r.id) AS cnt
    FROM cards c
    JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.ispromo
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS mx FROM ruling_counts
)
SELECT DISTINCT rc.name, rc.artist, rc.ispromo
FROM ruling_counts rc
WHERE rc.cnt = (SELECT mx FROM max_count)

SELECT s.county AS county_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(sat.numtsttakr), 0) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.magnet = 1
GROUP BY s.county

SELECT s."city",
       COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS "magnet_provision2_school_count"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "frpm" f
  ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."magnet" = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" IN ('Breakfast Provision 2', 'Lunch Provision 2')
  AND s."city" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s."city"

SELECT s.school AS school_name,
       s.street,
       s.city,
       s.state,
       s.zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."School Type" IN (
        'High Schools (Public)',
        'Continuation High Schools (Public)',
        'High Schools in 1 School District (Public)'
      )
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
ORDER BY s.school

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.cdscode,
        s.school AS school_name,
        s.county,
        s.city,
        s.mailstreet,
        s.mailcity,
        s.mailstate,
        s.mailzip,
        s.website,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment,

JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE u.displayname = 'Community'

SELECT p.id, u.displayname
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creaiondate) = 2010
ORDER BY p.favoritecount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT viewcount, lasteditordisplayname
FROM posts
WHERE title = 'Computer game datasets'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM posts
WHERE owneruserid = (
    SELECT id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.text, u.displayname
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id
JOIN users u ON c.userid = u.id
WHERE p.title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.creationdate DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM comments c
WHERE c.score = 0
  AND c.postid IN (
      SELECT cc.postid
      FROM comments cc
      GROUP BY cc.postid
      HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM posts p
      WHERE p.id = c.postid
  )

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.age)::numeric, 2) AS avg_age
FROM users u
WHERE u.id IN (
    SELECT c.userid
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.text LIKE '%http://%'
)

SELECT SUM(u.reputation) AS total_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.location = 'United Kingdom'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM posts p
      WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id
  )

SELECT SUM(u.reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.id IN (
    SELECT p.owneruserid
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.score = 10
      AND p.tags LIKE '%<r>%'
)

WITH organizer_holders AS (
    SELECT b.userid, MIN(b.date) AS organizer_date
    FROM badges b
    JOIN users u ON u.id = b.userid
    WHERE b.name = 'Organizer'
      AND u.location ILIKE '%Germany%'
    GROUP BY b.userid
),
prior_counts AS (
    SELECT o.userid, o.organizer_date, COUNT(b.id) AS prior_badges
    FROM organizer_holders o
    LEFT JOIN badges b
           ON b.userid = o.userid
          AND b.date < o.organizer_date
          AND b.name <> 'Organizer'
    GROUP BY o.userid, o.organizer_date
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM prior_counts
WHERE prior_badges >= 5

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.reputation)) AS avg_reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%'
  AND p.score < 20

WITH first_posts AS (
    SELECT owneruserid, MIN(creaiondate) AS first_date
    FROM posts
    WHERE owneruserid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY owneruserid
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM first_posts fp
JOIN users u ON u.id = fp.owneruserid
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fp.first_date) = 2010
  AND u.location ~* '\mIndia\M'

SELECT SUM(u.reputation) AS total_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.id IN (
    SELECT p.owneruserid
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.tags LIKE '%<r>%'
      AND p.lasactivitydate >= '2014-08-27'
      AND p.lasactivitydate < '2014-08-28'
      AND p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL
)

WITH german_users AS (
    SELECT id, reputation
    FROM users
    WHERE location ILIKE '%Germany%'
),
posts_2012 AS (
    SELECT id, score, lasteditoruserid
    FROM posts
    WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01'
),
tagged_posts AS (
    SELECT p.score,
           (g.id IS NOT NULL) AS is_german_editor
    FROM posts_2012 p
    LEFT JOIN german_users g ON p.lasteditoruserid = g.id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) FROM tagged_posts WHERE is_german_editor) AS german_editor_post_score,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) FROM tagged_posts WHERE NOT is_german_editor) AS other_post_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.id)
       FROM german_users g
       JOIN posts_2012 p ON p.lasteditoruserid = g.id) AS german_editor_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.reputation), 0)
       FROM german_users g
       WHERE g.id IN (SELECT lasteditoruserid FROM posts_2012 WHERE lasteditoruserid IS NOT NULL)) AS german_editor_reputation

SELECT SUM(linking.score) AS total_score
FROM postlinks AS pl
INNER JOIN posts AS linking ON linking.id = pl.postid
INNER JOIN posts AS target ON target.id = pl.relatedpostid
WHERE target.title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND linking.tags LIKE '%<r>%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.userid) AS user_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.id = b.userid
WHERE b.name = 'Yearling'
  AND b.date < TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE '2014-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND u.location ILIKE '%india%'

WITH ca_users AS (
    SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation
    FROM users
    WHERE location ILIKE '%california%'
       OR location ~ '(^|[^A-Za-z])CA([^A-Za-z]|$)'
)
SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation
FROM ca_users
WHERE views = (SELECT MAX(views) FROM ca_users)

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT u.id,
           u.displayname,
           COUNT(b.id) AS badge_total
    FROM users u
    JOIN badges b ON b.userid = u.id
    WHERE u.location ILIKE '%Germany%'
    GROUP BY u.id, u.displayname
),
second_total AS (
    SELECT MAX(badge_total) AS t
    FROM counts
    WHERE badge_total < (SELECT MAX(badge_total) FROM counts)
)
SELECT c.displayname,
       c.badge_total
FROM counts c
JOIN second_total s ON c.badge_total = s.t
ORDER BY c.displayname

WITH york_users AS (
    SELECT id, reputation, age
    FROM users
    WHERE TRIM(location) ILIKE 'york'
       OR location ILIKE 'york, england%'
       OR location ILIKE 'york, uk%'
       OR location ILIKE 'york, united kingdom%'
       OR location ILIKE 'york, north yorkshire%'
)
SELECT age
FROM york_users
WHERE reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM york_users)

SELECT id
FROM users
WHERE displayname = 'Michael'
ORDER BY creationdate DESC, id ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.displayname) AS distinct_display_names
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.userid = u.id
WHERE b.name = 'Supporter'
  AND u.age BETWEEN 19 AND 65

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.reputation)::numeric, 2) AS avg_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(u.location)) = 'india'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM posts p
      WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id
        AND p.creaiondate >= '2010-01-01'
        AND p.creaiondate < '2011-01-01'
  )

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT p.id,
           p.title,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS related_count
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON pl.postid = p.id
    WHERE p.title ILIKE '%principal component scores%'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.title
)
SELECT title,
       related_count
FROM counts
WHERE related_count = (SELECT MAX(related_count) FROM counts)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                        WHEN p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL THEN 'id:' || p.owneruserid::text
                        ELSE 'name:' || p.ownerdisplayname
                      END) AS bounty_user_count
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON p.id = v.postid
WHERE v.bountyamount >= 30
  AND v.creationdate >= DATE '2010-01-01'
  AND v.creationdate < DATE '2011-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.reputation, 0) < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
WHERE p.creaiondate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.creaiondate < '2011-01-01'
  AND p.score > 5

WITH active_users AS (
    SELECT owneruserid AS userid
    FROM posts
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creaiondate) = 2012
      AND owneruserid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY owneruserid
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
user_upvotes AS (
    SELECT a.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS upvotes
    FROM active_users a
    LEFT JOIN votes v
      ON v.userid = a.userid
     AND v.votetypeid = 2
    GROUP BY a.userid
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(uu.upvotes), 2) AS avg_upvotes,
       ROUND(AVG(u.age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM user_upvotes uu
JOIN users u ON u.id = uu.userid

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pl.creationdate)::int AS m,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS cnt
    FROM postlinks pl
    JOIN posts p ON p.id = pl.postid
    WHERE p.answercount <= 2
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pl.creationdate) = 2010
    GROUP BY 1
),
months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(1, 12) AS m
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mo.cnt, 0))::numeric / 12, 2) AS average
FROM months
LEFT JOIN monthly mo ON months.m = mo.m

WITH target AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM posts
    WHERE title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
),
editor_counts AS (
    SELECT ph.userid,
           ph.userdisplayname,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM posthistory ph
    WHERE ph.postid IN (SELECT id FROM target)
      AND ph.comment IS NOT NULL
      AND ph.comment <> ''
    GROUP BY ph.userid, ph.userdisplayname
)
SELECT userdisplayname, cnt
FROM editor_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM editor_counts)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.customerid,
           c.segment,
           SUM(y.consumption::numeric) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT segment,
           total,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total ASC, customerid ASC) AS rn
    FROM totals
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT segment, total
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(((SELECT total FROM lowest WHERE segment = 'SME') - (SELECT total FROM lowest WHERE segment = 'LAM')), 2) AS sme_minus_lam,
       ROUND(((SELECT total FROM lowest WHERE segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT total FROM lowest WHERE segment = 'KAM')), 2) AS lam_minus_kam,
       ROUND(((SELECT total FROM lowest WHERE segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT total FROM lowest WHERE segment = 'SME')), 2) AS kam_minus_sme

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM customers c
WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM yearmonth y
        WHERE y.customerid = c.customerid
          AND y.date LIKE '2012%'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM yearmonth y
        WHERE y.customerid = c.customerid
          AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
  )

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS c2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS c2013
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT segment,
           ROUND(((c2013 - c2012) / c2012 * 100), 2) AS increase_pct
    FROM seg
)
SELECT segment, increase_pct
FROM pct
WHERE increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM pct)
   OR increase_pct = (SELECT MIN(increase_pct) FROM pct)

SELECT ROUND(
    (
        (SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END))
        / SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)
    )::numeric, 4) AS relative_change
FROM yearmonth y
WHERE y.customerid = (
    SELECT t.customerid
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.date = '2012-08-25'
      AND ABS(t.price - 634.8) < 0.01
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
JOIN (
    SELECT y.customerid
    FROM yearmonth y
    WHERE y.date LIKE '2012%'
    GROUP BY y.customerid
    HAVING SUM(y.consumption) < 30000
) t ON t.customerid = c.customerid
GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT c.segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerid) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y
  ON y.customerid = c.customerid
WHERE y.date LIKE '2013%'
  AND y.consumption > 0
GROUP BY c.segment

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(t.date + t.time::time) - MIN(t.date + t.time::time))) / 60) AS minutes
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid
WHERE g.country = 'CZE'
  AND t.price > 1000

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING("date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS yr,
           SUBSTRING("date" FROM 5 FOR 2) AS mo,
           SUM("consumption")::numeric AS total
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE SUBSTRING("date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
peaks AS (
    SELECT yr, MAX(total) AS peak
    FROM monthly
    GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN peak END)
           - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN peak END)) AS difference
FROM peaks

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT y.customerid
    FROM yearmonth y
    WHERE y.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201311'
    GROUP BY y.customerid
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT y.date) = 11
),
currency_counts AS (
    SELECT c.currency, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = q.customerid
    GROUP BY c.currency
)
SELECT currency, cnt
FROM currency_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM currency_counts)

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(ym.consumption) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
WHERE ym.customerid = 15621
  AND ym.date LIKE '2013%'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM transactions_1k t
      WHERE t.customerid = ym.customerid
        AND to_char(t.date, 'YYYYMM') = ym.date
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.customerid
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE c.segment = 'KAM'
      AND c.currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.customerid
    HAVING SUM(y.consumption) > 1000000
) t

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN y.consumption END)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN y.customerid END), 0),
        2
    ) AS eur_avg_quarterly_consumption,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN y.consumption END)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.currency = 'CZK' THEN y.customerid END), 0),
        2
    ) AS czk_avg_quarterly_consumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = y.customerid
WHERE y.date IN ('201304', '201305', '201306')

WITH customer_2012 AS (
    SELECT c.customerid,
           c.currency,
           SUM(y.consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.customerid = c.customerid
    WHERE LEFT(y.date, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.customerid, c.currency
)
SELECT ROUND((AVG(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN total_consumption END)
            - AVG(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN total_consumption END))::numeric) AS difference
FROM customer_2012

SELECT l.name
FROM match m
JOIN league l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal)

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM team_attributes ta
JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.date LIKE '2012%'
  AND ta.buildupplaypassing > (
      SELECT AVG(buildupplaypassing)
      FROM team_attributes
      WHERE date LIKE '2012%'
  )

WITH away_wins AS (
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM match m
    JOIN league l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM away_wins aw
JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = aw.away_team_api_id
WHERE aw.wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM away_wins)

SELECT p.player_name
FROM player p
JOIN player_attributes pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.customerid) AS sme_gas_customers_feb_2013
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = t.customerid
WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
  AND t.date >= DATE '2013-02-01'
  AND t.date < DATE '2013-03-01'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END)
     - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END) AS ball_control_mean_difference
FROM player p
JOIN player_attributes pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye')

WITH extremes AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM player
    WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM player)
       OR height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM player)
),
avg_finishing AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM player_attributes pa
    WHERE pa.player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM extremes)
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
)
SELECT e.player_name
FROM avg_finishing af
JOIN extremes e ON e.player_api_id = af.player_api_id
ORDER BY af.avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.date
FROM player_attributes pa
JOIN player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
      FROM player_attributes pa2
      JOIN player p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
      WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY pa.date ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT p.player_name,
           pa.overall_rating,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) AS rn
    FROM player p
    JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
)
SELECT ROUND(
           (a.overall_rating - b.overall_rating)::numeric / b.overall_rating * 100,
           2
       ) AS percentage_difference
FROM (SELECT overall_rating FROM latest WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' AND rn = 1) a,
     (SELECT overall_rating FROM latest WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel' AND rn = 1) b

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN p.player_api_id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_attributes pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height < 180

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM player p
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND p.player_api_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT m.home_player_3
      FROM match m
      WHERE m.home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  )

WITH player_flags AS (
    SELECT pl.player_api_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_high
    FROM player pl
    JOIN player_attributes pa
      ON pa.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTRING(pl.birthday FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1991
      AND pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
    GROUP BY pl.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_high) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_defensive_work_rate_pct
FROM player_flags

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.weight), 1) AS average_weight
FROM player AS p
INNER JOIN player_attributes AS pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left'

WITH shortlist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM player_attributes
    WHERE LEFT(date, 10) = '2010-12-31'
      AND overall_rating > 80
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT id, UNNEST(ARRAY[
        home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4, home_player_5,
        home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8, home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11,
        away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4, away_player_5,
        away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8, away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
    ]) AS pid
    FROM match
    WHERE season = '2010/2011'
),
counts AS (
    SELECT s.player_api_id, COUNT(pm.id) AS cnt
    FROM shortlist s
    LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON pm.pid = s.player_api_id
    GROUP BY s.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_matches
FROM counts

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT player_api_id,
           defensive_work_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS rn
    FROM player_attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM latest l
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = l.player_api_id
WHERE l.rn = 1
  AND l.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high')

WITH latest_rating AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pa.player_api_id)
           pa.player_api_id,
           pa.defensive_work_rate
    FROM player_attributes pa
    WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(pa.defensive_work_rate) <> ''
    ORDER BY pa.player_api_id, pa.date DESC
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM player p
JOIN latest_rating lr
  ON lr.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(lr.defensive_work_rate)) = 'medium'
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birthday FROM 1 FOR 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1995

SELECT ta.buildupplaydribblingclass
FROM team_attributes ta
JOIN team t
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'POR'
  AND ta.team_api_id IN (
        SELECT m.home_team_api_id
        FROM match m
        JOIN country c ON m.country_id = c.id
        WHERE c.name = 'England'
        UNION
        SELECT m.away_team_api_id
        FROM match m
        JOIN country c ON m.country_id = c.id
        WHERE c.name = 'England'
  )
  AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%'

SELECT p.player_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matches_played
FROM match m
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4),
    (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6), (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8),
    (m.home_player_9), (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
    (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3), (m.away_player_4),
    (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6), (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8),
    (m.away_player_9), (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
) AS l(player_api_id)
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = l.player_api_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND p.player_name LIKE 'Adam%'
  AND p.weight > 170
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name

WITH risky_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
    FROM team_attributes
    WHERE chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky'
),
clubs AS (
    SELECT t.team_api_id, t.team_short_name
    FROM team t
    JOIN risky_teams r ON r.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
),
in_force AS (
    SELECT ta.team_api_id,
           ta.chancecreationpassing,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY CAST(ta.date AS timestamp) DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_attributes ta
    WHERE CAST(ta.date AS timestamp) < '2014-09-20 00:00:00'
)
SELECT c.team_short_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.team_api_id) AS club_count,
       ROUND(AVG(f.chancecreationpassing), 1) AS avg_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM clubs c
LEFT JOIN in_force f
       ON f.team_api_id = c.team_api_id
      AND f.rn = 1
GROUP BY c.team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.team_api_id) > 1
ORDER BY avg_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC NULLS LAST, c.team_short_name

SELECT m.season,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS number_of_players
FROM match m
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY[
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
    m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
    m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
]) AS p(player_id)
WHERE m.away_team_goal - m.home_team_goal >= 5
  AND p.player_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.season
ORDER BY m.season

WITH latest_rating AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pa.player_api_id)
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.volleys
    FROM player_attributes pa
    ORDER BY pa.player_api_id, pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM latest_rating lr
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = lr.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND lr.volleys > 70

WITH latest_speed AS (
    SELECT m.id AS match_id,
           ta.buildupplayspeedclass,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY m.id
               ORDER BY CAST(ta.date AS timestamp) DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM match m
    JOIN team_attributes ta
      ON ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
    WHERE CAST(ta.date AS timestamp) <= CAST(m.date AS timestamp)
),
fast_home_wins AS (
    SELECT m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           m.id AS match_id
    FROM match m
    JOIN latest_speed ls
      ON ls.match_id = m.id
     AND ls.rn = 1
    WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
      AND ls.buildupplayspeedclass = 'Fast'
),
win_counts AS (
    SELECT t.team_api_id,
           t.team_long_name,
           t.team_short_name,
           COUNT(*) AS home_wins
    FROM fast_home_wins f
    JOIN team t
      ON t.team_api_id = f.team_api_id
    GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
)
SELECT team_long_name,
       team_short_name,
       home_wins
FROM win_counts
WHERE home_wins = (SELECT MAX(home_wins) FROM win_counts)

WITH heavy AS (
    SELECT l.country_id, p.pid
    FROM match m
    JOIN league l ON l.id = m.league_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4),
        (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6), (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8),
        (m.home_player_9), (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
        (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3), (m.away_player_4),
        (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6), (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8),
        (m.away_player_9), (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
    ) AS p(pid)
    JOIN player pl ON pl.player_api_id = p.pid
    WHERE pl.weight >= 210
),
counts AS (
    SELECT c.name AS country, COUNT(*) AS num_players
    FROM heavy h
    JOIN country c ON c.id = h.country_id
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT country, num_players
FROM counts
WHERE num_players = (SELECT MAX(num_players) FROM counts)
ORDER BY country

SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.total_goals), 2) AS avg_total_home_goals
FROM (
    SELECT m.home_player_3, SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM match m
    WHERE m.home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.home_player_3
) t

WITH lineup AS (
    SELECT m.season,
           unnest(ARRAY[
               m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
               m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
               m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
               m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,

               m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11

    FROM match m
    JOIN country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
      AND m.season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
),
season_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT season, player_api_id
    FROM lineup
    WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sp.season,
       COUNT(*) AS player_count,
       ROUND(AVG(p.height)::numeric, 2) AS avg_height
FROM season_players sp
JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = sp.player_api_id
GROUP BY sp.season
ORDER BY sp.season

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM player_attributes
WHERE date LIKE '2015-01-01%'
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium')

SELECT COUNT(id) AS player_count
FROM player_attributes
WHERE jumping >= 80
  AND LEFT(date, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2007-08-30'

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM player_attributes
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS low_attacking_work_rate_percentage
FROM latest
WHERE rn = 1
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT m.country_id, u.pid
    FROM match m
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4),
        (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6), (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8),
        (m.home_player_9), (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
        (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3), (m.away_player_4),
        (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6), (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8),
        (m.away_player_9), (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
    ) AS u(pid)
    WHERE u.pid IS NOT NULL
),
light_counts AS (
    SELECT mp.country_id, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.pid) AS light_players
    FROM match_players mp
    JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = mp.pid
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY mp.country_id
),
country_counts AS (
    SELECT c.name, COALESCE(lc.light_players, 0) AS light_players
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_id FROM match) mc
    JOIN country c ON c.id = mc.country_id
    LEFT JOIN light_counts lc ON lc.country_id = mc.country_id
)
SELECT name
FROM country_counts
WHERE light_players = (SELECT MIN(light_players) FROM country_counts)

WITH t AS (
    SELECT team_api_id
    FROM team
    WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
),
lm AS (
    SELECT m.date
    FROM match m
    CROSS JOIN t
    WHERE m.season = '2012/2013'
      AND (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
    ORDER BY m.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
FROM team_attributes ta
CROSS JOIN t
CROSS JOIN lm
WHERE ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  AND ta.date <= lm.date
ORDER BY ta.date DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT x.match_id) AS matches_played
FROM player p
JOIN (
    SELECT m.id AS match_id, l.pid
    FROM match m
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4),
        (m.home_player_5), (m.home_player_6), (m.home_player_7), (m.home_player_8),
        (m.home_player_9), (m.home_player_10), (m.home_player_11),
        (m.away_player_1), (m.away_player_2), (m.away_player_3), (m.away_player_4),
        (m.away_player_5), (m.away_player_6), (m.away_player_7), (m.away_player_8),
        (m.away_player_9), (m.away_player_10), (m.away_player_11)
    ) AS l(pid)

) x ON x.pid = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
