GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH donovan AS (
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM player_attributes pa
    JOIN player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
      AND SUBSTRING(pa.date, 1, 10) = '2013-07-12'
),
avg_rating AS (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall
    FROM player_attributes
    WHERE SUBSTRING(date, 1, 10) = '2013-07-12'
      AND defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT ROUND((((d.overall_rating - a.avg_overall) / a.avg_overall) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pct_higher
FROM donovan d
CROSS JOIN avg_rating a

SELECT T3.district_id
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

WITH low_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY a11 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
oldest_female AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM low_district)
    ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM district) AS salary_difference
FROM disp d
JOIN oldest_female o ON d.client_id = o.client_id

WITH top_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE LOWER(a3) = 'south bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
           2
       ) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN top_district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d
  ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE LOWER(d.a3) = 'east bohemia'
  AND a.date >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date <= DATE '2000-12-31'

SELECT d.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.a11 > 8000
  AND dist.a11 <= 9000
  AND d.type <> 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.type

WITH acc AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
),
start_bal AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN acc ON t.account_id = acc.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
end_bal AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN acc ON t.account_id = acc.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (e.balance - s.balance) * 100.0 / s.balance AS percentage_increase
FROM start_bal s, end_bal e

SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol
FROM account a
JOIN "order" o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND o.amount = 3539

SELECT d.district_id,
       ROUND((((d.a13 - d.a12) / d.a12) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS unemployment_rate_change_pct
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
        SELECT a.district_id
        FROM loan l
        JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE l.status = 'D'
      )
  AND d.a12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.a13 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.a12 <> 0

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
       * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
       AS percentage_growth
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND l.date >= '1996-01-01'
  AND l.date < '1998-01-01'

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(date)) AS m_start
    FROM account
),
candidate_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    CROSS JOIN first_month f
    WHERE a.date >= f.m_start
      AND a.date < f.m_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
)
SELECT d.district_id,
       CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) AS population
FROM district d
JOIN candidate_districts c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(d2.a4 AS bigint))
    FROM district d2
    JOIN candidate_districts c2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE LOWER(d.a3) = 'north bohemia'
  AND a.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
  AND t.bank = 'AB'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM trans t
WHERE (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')
  AND t.account_id IN (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM disp d
      JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
      WHERE c.gender = 'M'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  )

WITH region_totals AS (
    SELECT d.a3 AS region,
           SUM(l.amount) AS total
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
      AND l.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
      AND (l.date + make_interval(months => l.duration::int)) > DATE '1995-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.a3
)
SELECT region, total
FROM region_totals
WHERE total = (SELECT MAX(total) FROM region_totals)

WITH top5 AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
acc AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS n_accounts
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
loans AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT t.a2 AS district_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(l.total_amount, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(acc.n_accounts, 0)) AS avg_active_loan
FROM top5 t
JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = t.district_id
LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.district_id = t.district_id
ORDER BY avg_active_loan DESC

WITH eb_districts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.a11
    FROM district d
    WHERE lower(trim(d.a3)) = 'east bohemia'
),
served_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_of_district_avg_salaries,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM eb_districts e
JOIN served_districts s ON s.district_id = e.district_id

WITH owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.loan_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM (
    SELECT oa.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM owner_accounts oa
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = oa.account_id
    GROUP BY oa.account_id
) t

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND dt.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp d2
          JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d2.disp_id
          WHERE d2.account_id = d.account_id
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(dt.a11::numeric), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM district dt
JOIN qualifying_districts q ON q.district_id = dt.district_id

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_payments,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
                       AND t.k_symbol <> ''
                       AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans t
WHERE t.amount > 4000
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp d
      JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
      WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id
        AND c.gender = 'M'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  )

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(t.amount), 0),
    2
) AS sipo_percentage
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''

WITH gold_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT di.account_id
    FROM disp di
    JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = di.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
      AND di.type = 'OWNER'
),
pair_totals AS (
    SELECT t.bank,
           t.account,
           COUNT(*) AS n_payments,
           SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
      AND CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) >= 250000
      AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_owner_accounts)
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
)
SELECT bank,
       account,
       n_payments,
       total_amount
FROM pair_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM pair_totals)

WITH prachatice_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.a2 = 'Prachatice'
),
loan_totals AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS counterparty_count
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
owners AS (
    SELECT di.account_id, c.district_id AS home_district_id
    FROM disp di
    JOIN client c ON di.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE di.type = 'OWNER'
),
base AS (
    SELECT pa.account_id,
           pa.open_date,
           lt.total_borrowed,
           COALESCE(cp.counterparty_count, 0) AS counterparty_count,
           o.home_district_id,
           CAST(dd.a4 AS bigint) AS district_population
    FROM prachatice_accounts pa
    JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.account_id = pa.account_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.account_id = pa.account_id
    JOIN owners o ON o.account_id = pa.account_id
    JOIN district dd ON dd.district_id = o.home_district_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       open_date,
       total_borrowed,
       counterparty_count,
       home_district_id,
       district_population,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC

WITH avg_bal AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
),
gold_holders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.gender, a.district_id
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp d    ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN avg_bal b ON b.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
),
dist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT g.gender, dd.district_id, dd.a4::bigint AS inhabitants, dd.a11, dd.a10
    FROM gold_holders g
    JOIN district dd ON dd.district_id = g.district_id
    WHERE dd.a4::bigint > 100000
),
stats AS (
    SELECT gender,
           COUNT(*) AS num_districts,
           ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(a10)::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM dist
    GROUP BY gender
),
top AS (
    SELECT gender, district_id, inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY inhabitants DESC) AS rk
        FROM dist d
    ) x
    WHERE rk = 1
)
SELECT t.gender,
       s.num_districts,
       t.district_id,
       t.inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM top t
JOIN stats s ON s.gender = t.gender
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.gender = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.district_id

WITH card_districts AS (
    SELECT c.type AS card_type,
           d.district_id,
           CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) AS inhabitants
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dp ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT card_type,
           district_id,
           inhabitants,
           MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM card_districts
)
SELECT DISTINCT card_type, district_id, inhabitants
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants
ORDER BY card_type, district_id

WITH qc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card cd WHERE cd.disp_id = d.disp_id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = d.account_id)
),
qd AS (
    SELECT qc.client_id, di.district_id, di.a2, di.a3, di.a4, di.a11, di.a13
    FROM qc
    JOIN district di ON di.district_id = qc.district_id
),
agg AS (
    SELECT a3 AS region,
           ROUND(AVG(a11::numeric), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(a13::numeric), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996
    FROM qd
    GROUP BY a3
),
top AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT district_id, a2, a3, a4 FROM qd) x
    ORDER BY a3, a4::bigint DESC, a2 ASC
)
SELECT agg.region,
       agg.avg_salary,
       agg.avg_unemployment_1996,
       top.a2 AS most_populous_district
FROM agg
JOIN top ON top.a3 = agg.region
ORDER BY agg.region

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.a2 AS district_name,
        d.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
        d.a16::bigint AS crimes_1996
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
    ORDER BY
        d.a4::bigint DESC,
        lower(translate(d.a2,
            'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ',
            'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ')) ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
top3_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(crimes_1996::numeric) AS top3_avg
    FROM top3
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(a16::numeric) AS overall_avg
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    t.district_name,
    t.crimes_1996,
    ROUND(ts.top3_avg, 2) AS three_district_avg_crimes_1996,
    ROUND(os.overall_avg, 2) AS overall_avg_crimes_1996,
    ROUND(ts.top3_avg - os.overall_avg, 2) AS difference
FROM top3 t
CROSS JOIN top3_stats ts
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
ORDER BY
    t.inhabitants DESC,
    lower(translate(t.district_name,
        'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ',
        'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ')) ASC

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount, a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
),
dists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.a4, d.a11
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM top_loans)
)
SELECT d.district_id,
       d.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(a11) FROM dists)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary
FROM dists d
ORDER BY d.a4::bigint DESC, d.district_id ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH region AS (
    SELECT a3 AS region_name
    FROM district
    WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'
),
acc AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.a3 = (SELECT region_name FROM region)
      AND a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
last_bal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.account_id) t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
),
accv AS (
    SELECT acc.account_id, acc.district_id, acc.district_name, lb.balance
    FROM acc
    LEFT JOIN last_bal lb ON lb.account_id = acc.account_id
),
dist AS (
    SELECT district_name,
           COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
           ROUND(AVG(balance)::numeric, 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM accv
    GROUP BY district_id, district_name
),
summary AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance)::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_balance
    FROM accv
),
top AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM dist
    ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.district_name,
       d.num_accounts,
       d.avg_balance,
       s.region_avg_balance,
       t.district_name AS top_district
FROM dist d
CROSS JOIN summary s
CROSS JOIN top t
ORDER BY d.district_name

WITH acc AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, TO_CHAR(a.date, 'YYYY') AS yr
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
),
acc_loan AS (
    SELECT acc.account_id, acc.district_id, acc.yr,
           COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS lent
    FROM acc
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = acc.account_id
    GROUP BY acc.account_id, acc.district_id, acc.yr
),
dist_year AS (
    SELECT yr, district_id,
           SUM(lent)::numeric AS dist_lent,
           COUNT(*) AS dist_accounts
    FROM acc_loan
    GROUP BY yr, district_id
),
year_tot AS (
    SELECT yr,
           COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
           SUM(lent)::numeric AS total_lent
    FROM acc_loan
    GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT yt.yr AS year,
       yt.num_accounts,
       yt.total_lent,
       ROUND(AVG(dy.dist_lent / dy.dist_accounts), 2) AS avg_lent_per_account_by_district
FROM year_tot yt
JOIN dist_year dy ON dy.yr = yt.yr
GROUP BY yt.yr, yt.num_accounts, yt.total_lent
ORDER BY yt.yr

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id,
           l.account_id,
           l.date,
           l.amount,
           a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
      AND l.duration = 24
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT t.district_id,
       t.amount,
       t.date,
       tr.balance
FROM top_loans t
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT tx.balance
    FROM trans tx
    WHERE tx.account_id = t.account_id
      AND tx.date = t.date
    ORDER BY tx.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) tr ON TRUE
ORDER BY t.amount DESC, t.date ASC

WITH wd AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
so AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           SUM(o.amount::numeric) AS so_total
    FROM "order" o
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
acc AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n_accounts
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT d.a2 AS district_name,
           d.a3 AS region,
           d.a4::bigint AS population,
           wd.total_withdrawn,
           ROUND(wd.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::bigint, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
           ROUND(COALESCE(so.so_total, 0) / acc.n_accounts, 2) AS avg_standing_order_per_account
    FROM district d
    JOIN wd ON wd.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN so ON so.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
)
SELECT district_name,
       region,
       population,
       total_withdrawn,
       withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
       avg_standing_order_per_account
FROM base
ORDER BY withdrawal_rank, district_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT t.bank,
       t.account,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = DATE '1996-01-03'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < DATE '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT d.a2 AS branch_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(d.a3)) = 'north moravia'
  AND t.date <= DATE '1998-10-14'
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
dist_rank AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           a2,
           a3,
           CAST(a4 AS bigint) AS pop,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC) AS pop_rank
    FROM district
),
region_info AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3)
           a3 AS region,
           a2 AS top_name,
           pop AS top_pop
    FROM dist_rank
    ORDER BY a3, pop DESC
),
region_clients AS (
    SELECT d.a3 AS region,
           COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_cnt
    FROM district d
    LEFT JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.a3
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS tx_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS income,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount END), 0) AS expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.date AS opened_date,
       a.frequency,
       d.a2 AS district_name,
       d.a3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN cl.district_id = d.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       d.a11 AS avg_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(t.tx_count, 0) AS tx_count,
       COALESCE(t.income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(t.income, 0) - COALESCE(t.expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       rc.client_cnt AS region_client_count,
       ri.top_name AS most_populous_district,
       ri.top_pop AS most_populous_population,
       dr.pop_rank AS population_rank_in_region
FROM client_accounts ca
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = 3541
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN region_clients rc ON rc.region = d.a3
JOIN region_info ri ON ri.region = d.a3
JOIN dist_rank dr ON dr.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY tx_count DESC, a.account_id

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        cd.type AS card_type,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cd.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date))::int AS age_at_issue,
        dp.account_id,
        d.a2 AS district_name,
        d.a11 AS avg_salary
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp dp ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE cd.issued >= DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND cd.issued <  DATE '1995-01-01'
),
loan_agg AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profiled AS (
    SELECT
        b.client_id,
        b.gender,
        b.birth_date,
        b.card_type,
        b.age_at_issue,
        COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(la.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) >= 1 AND b.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
            WHEN COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) >= 1 AND b.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
            ELSE 'Non-borrower'
        END AS borrower_classification,
        b.district_name,
        b.avg_salary
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON b.account_id = la.account_id
)
SELECT
    client_id,
    gender,
    birth_date,
    card_type,
    age_at_issue,
    loan_count,
    total_amount,
    borrower_classification,
    district_name,
    avg_salary,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM profiled
ORDER BY client_id

WITH acc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id = 2823
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
     - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SMRT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_interest
FROM trans t
JOIN acc a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND t.k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SMRT')

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date <  DATE '1998-01-01'
      AND CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) >= 100000
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM qualifying_accounts
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying_accounts) AS total_monthly_accounts_1997,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying_districts) AS district_count,
    ROUND((SELECT AVG(d.a11)
           FROM district d
           JOIN qualifying_districts q ON q.district_id = d.district_id), 2) AS avg_salary

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT d.a3 AS region,
           d.district_id,
           d.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
           a.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND l.date < DATE '1997-01-01'
),
district_level AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT region, district_id, inhabitants
    FROM qualifying
),
region_districts AS (
    SELECT region,
           COUNT(*) AS num_districts,
           SUM(inhabitants) AS total_inhabitants
    FROM district_level
    GROUP BY region
),
region_accounts AS (
    SELECT region,
           COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS num_accounts
    FROM qualifying
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT rd.region,
       rd.num_districts,
       rd.total_inhabitants,
       ra.num_accounts
FROM region_districts rd
JOIN region_accounts ra ON ra.region = rd.region
ORDER BY rd.total_inhabitants DESC, rd.region ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary
FROM client c
JOIN disp di ON di.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = di.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2)
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01'
)

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
                            THEN t.bank || '/' || t.account::text END) AS counterparties
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_agg AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
)
SELECT
    g.account_id,
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(t.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(t.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(t.counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.counterparties, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM gold_accounts g
JOIN district d ON g.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t ON t.account_id = g.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg l ON l.account_id = g.account_id
ORDER BY rank, g.account_id

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
)

WITH classic_owners AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'classic'
),
client_stats AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT co.client_id) AS num_clients
    FROM classic_owners co
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = co.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
owned_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM classic_owners
),
pay_stats AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank || '|' || t.account::text)) AS num_external_accounts,
           SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN owned_accounts oa ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT d.a2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(cs.num_clients, 0) AS num_clients,
       COALESCE(ps.num_external_accounts, 0) AS num_external_accounts,
       COALESCE(ps.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN client_stats cs ON cs.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN pay_stats ps ON ps.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC

WITH cohort_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id,
           CASE
               WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birth_date) >= 1980 THEN 'young'
               WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birth_date) <= 1919 THEN 'old'
           END AS cohort
    FROM client
),
cohort_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.cohort, a.district_id
    FROM cohort_clients cc
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = cc.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE cc.cohort IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT cd.cohort,
       ROUND(AVG(di.a11::numeric), 0) AS avg_salary
FROM cohort_districts cd
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = cd.district_id
GROUP BY cd.cohort
ORDER BY CASE WHEN cd.cohort = 'young' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
top_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT fl.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fl.amount DESC) AS rk
        FROM female_loans fl
    ) r
    WHERE r.rk <= 3
),
trans_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    t.client_id,
    t.amount AS loan_amount,
    t.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND((t.payments::numeric * t.duration), 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND((t.payments::numeric * t.duration - t.amount), 2) AS interest_paid,
    t.status AS loan_status,
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(ts.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM loan l2
        JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = a2.district_id
        WHERE d2.a3 = d.a3
    ) AS region_loan_count,
    (
        SELECT ROUND(AVG(d3.a11)::numeric, 2)
        FROM district d3
        WHERE d3.a3 = d.a3
    ) AS region_avg_salary,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', t.birth_date))::int AS client_age
FROM top_loans t
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON ts.account_id = t.account_id
ORDER BY t.amount DESC

SELECT ROUND(((a.speed - b.speed) / b.speed * 100)::numeric, 2) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS numeric) AS speed
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r.raceid = 853
) a
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS numeric) AS speed
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r.raceid = 854
) b

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010

WITH tabor_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor'
),
owner AS (
    SELECT dp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards AS (
    SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n_cards
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp dp ON cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loans AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n_loans,
           CASE
               WHEN BOOL_OR(l.status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN BOOL_OR(l.status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_label
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
trx AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n_trans,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' OR t.operation = 'VYBER' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS money_out,
           MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND t.date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
profile AS (
    SELECT ta.account_id,
           ta.open_date,
           o.gender,
           CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date)) AS integer) AS age,
           COALESCE(c.n_cards, 0) AS n_cards,
           COALESCE(l.n_loans, 0) AS n_loans,
           COALESCE(l.loan_label, 'no loan') AS loan_label,
           COALESCE(x.n_trans, 0) AS n_trans,
           COALESCE(x.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(x.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(x.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM tabor_accounts ta
    LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trx x ON x.account_id = ta.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       open_date,
       gender,
       age,
       n_cards,
       n_loans,
       loan_label,
       n_trans,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_rank
FROM profile
ORDER BY peak_rank, account_id

WITH top_winner AS (
    SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM results
    WHERE positionorder = 1
    GROUP BY driverid
    ORDER BY win_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.forename,
       d.surname,
       d.nationality,
       MAX(ds.points) AS highest_points
FROM top_winner tw
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = tw.driverid
JOIN driverstandings ds ON ds.driverid = tw.driverid
GROUP BY d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND r.laps > 50) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.laps = w.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN results w ON w.raceid = r.raceid AND w.positionorder = 1
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceid
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1988 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
winner AS (
    SELECT r.milliseconds
    FROM results r
    JOIN race ON r.raceid = race.raceid
    WHERE r.positionorder = 1
),
last_finisher AS (
    SELECT r.milliseconds
    FROM results r
    JOIN race ON r.raceid = race.raceid
    WHERE r.statusid = 1
    ORDER BY r.positionorder DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(((l.milliseconds - w.milliseconds)::numeric / l.milliseconds) * 100, 2) AS percentage_shorter
FROM winner w, last_finisher l

SELECT r.year,
       ROUND(AVG(res.milliseconds) / 1000.0, 2) AS mean_winner_time_seconds
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE res.positionorder = 1
  AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  AND r.year < 1975
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

SELECT SUM(r.points) AS score,
       c.name,
       c.nationality
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorid = c.constructorid
WHERE ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY (split_part(q.q3, ':', 1)::numeric * 60 + split_part(q.q3, ':', 2)::numeric) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM laptimes AS lt
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 20

SELECT c.name AS circuit_name,
       (MIN(l.milliseconds) / 60000)::text || ':' ||
       LPAD(((MIN(l.milliseconds) % 60000) / 1000)::text, 2, '0') || '.' ||
       LPAD((MIN(l.milliseconds) % 1000)::text, 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
JOIN laptimes l ON l.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name

SELECT d.forename,
       d.surname,
       d.url,
       d.dob,
       COUNT(NULLIF(q.q3, '')) AS q3_count
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN qualifying q
       ON q.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob BETWEEN DATE '1971-01-01' AND DATE '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_count DESC, d.dob ASC

WITH eligible_races AS (
    SELECT r.raceid
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM races r2
          WHERE r2.year = 2000
            AND r2.name = r.name
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(
           COUNT(p.raceid)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.raceid), 0),
           2
       ) AS avg_pit_stops_per_race
FROM eligible_races e
LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON p.raceid = e.raceid

WITH japan_q1 AS (
    SELECT q.driverid, q.q1
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
    WHERE r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND r.year = 1995
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.driverref, d.nationality, d.dob, j.q1
FROM japan_q1 j
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = j.driverid
WHERE j.q1 = (SELECT MAX(q1) FROM japan_q1)

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        qu.q1,
        (split_part(qu.q1, ':', 1)::numeric * 60
         + split_part(qu.q1, ':', 2)::numeric) AS q1_seconds
    FROM qualifying qu
    JOIN races r ON qu.raceid = r.raceid
    JOIN drivers d ON qu.driverid = d.driverid
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND qu.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND qu.q1 <> ''
)
SELECT forename, surname, q1
FROM q1_times
WHERE q1_seconds = (SELECT MIN(q1_seconds) FROM q1_times)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q2.driverid) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying q1
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q1.driverid
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q1.raceid
JOIN qualifying q2 ON q2.raceid = q1.raceid

WHERE d.forename = 'Lucas'

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT
        d.nationality,
        (split_part(q.q1, ':', 1)::numeric * 60 + split_part(q.q1, ':', 2)::numeric) AS q1_seconds
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
    JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q1 <> ''
)
SELECT nationality
FROM q1_times
WHERE q1_seconds = (SELECT MAX(q1_seconds) FROM q1_times)

SELECT d.forename,

FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'

GROUP BY d.forename

WITH q2_times AS (
    SELECT d.nationality,
           split_part(qu.q2, ':', 1)::int * 60000
         + split_part(split_part(qu.q2, ':', 2), '.', 1)::int * 1000
         + split_part(split_part(qu.q2, ':', 2), '.', 2)::int AS q2_ms
    FROM qualifying qu
    JOIN races r ON qu.raceid = r.raceid
    JOIN drivers d ON qu.driverid = d.driverid

      AND qu.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND qu.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT nationality
FROM q2_times
WHERE q2_ms = (SELECT MIN(q2_ms) FROM q2_times)

SELECT d.driverref,

       d.dob
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r   ON r.raceid = q.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND NULLIF(q.q2, '') IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying q

WHERE r.year = 2017

  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.name,

FROM pitstops p
JOIN races r ON p.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
WHERE p.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitstops)

JOIN results res ON res.raceid = ra.raceid

SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_q3_laps
FROM (

           COUNT(NULLIF(q.q3, '')) AS q3_count

WITH q2t AS (
    SELECT q.driverid,
           (split_part(q.q2, ':', 1)::int * 60000
            + replace(split_part(q.q2, ':', 2), '.', '')::int) AS ms
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
    WHERE r.year = 2017

second_time AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ms
    FROM q2t
    ORDER BY ms
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)

FROM q2t
JOIN second_time st ON q2t.ms = st.ms
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q2t.driverid

FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN results r
       ON r.driverid = d.driverid
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM laptimes l
            WHERE l.raceid = r.raceid
              AND l.driverid = r.driverid
          )
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.driverref

WITH shared_forenames AS (
    SELECT forename
    FROM drivers
    GROUP BY forename
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.code IS NULL
  AND d.forename IN (SELECT forename FROM shared_forenames)
  AND q.q1 > '2:00.000'

WITH italian_q3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        qu.q3,
        (split_part(qu.q3, ':', 1)::int * 60
         + split_part(split_part(qu.q3, ':', 2), '.', 1)::int) * 1000
         + split_part(qu.q3, '.', 2)::int AS q3_ms
    FROM qualifying qu
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = qu.driverid
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
      AND qu.q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]+$'
)
SELECT DISTINCT forename, surname, q3
FROM italian_q3
WHERE q3_ms = (SELECT MIN(q3_ms) FROM italian_q3)

WITH q3_times AS (
    SELECT qu.raceid,
           qu.driverid,
           qu.q3,
           split_part(qu.q3, ':', 1)::numeric * 60000
           + split_part(qu.q3, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000 AS q3_ms
    FROM qualifying qu
    WHERE qu.q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]+$'
),
british_q3 AS (
    SELECT t.raceid,
           t.q3,
           t.q3_ms,
           d.forename,
           d.surname
    FROM q3_times t
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = t.driverid
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) > 1980
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(q3_ms) AS best_ms
    FROM british_q3
)
SELECT b.forename || ' ' || b.surname AS driver_name,
       r.name AS race_name,
       r.year AS race_year,
       b.q3 AS q3_time
FROM british_q3 b
JOIN fastest f ON b.q3_ms = f.best_ms
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = b.raceid

WITH italian_race AS (
    SELECT raceid
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q3_times AS (
    SELECT d.driverref,
           split_part(qu.q3, ':', 1)::numeric * 60
             + split_part(qu.q3, ':', 2)::numeric AS q3_seconds
    FROM qualifying qu
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = qu.driverid
    WHERE qu.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM italian_race)
      AND qu.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND qu.q3 <> ''
)
SELECT driverref
FROM q3_times
WHERE q3_seconds = (SELECT MIN(q3_seconds) FROM q3_times)

WITH valid_laps AS (
    SELECT r.raceid,
           r.driverid,
           split_part(r.fastestlaptime, ':', 1)::numeric * 60
           + split_part(r.fastestlaptime, ':', 2)::numeric AS lap_seconds
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.fastestlaptime ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT raceid,
           driverid,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY lap_seconds) AS lap_rank
    FROM valid_laps
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid)
FROM drivers d
JOIN ranked k ON k.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.dob >= DATE '1976-01-01'
  AND k.lap_rank = 2

WITH french_editions AS (
    SELECT r.raceid, r.date
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
      AND r.year >= 1990
),
driver_best_laps AS (
    SELECT l.raceid, l.driverid, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS best_ms
    FROM laptimes l
    GROUP BY l.raceid, l.driverid
)
SELECT
    fe.date,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    (dbl.best_ms / 60000)::text
        || ':' || lpad(((dbl.best_ms % 60000) / 1000)::text, 2, '0')
        || '.' || lpad((dbl.best_ms % 1000)::text, 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM french_editions fe
LEFT JOIN driver_best_laps dbl
       ON dbl.raceid = fe.raceid
      AND dbl.best_ms > 90000
LEFT JOIN drivers d
       ON d.driverid = dbl.driverid
ORDER BY fe.date, d.surname, d.forename

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.forename = 'Peter' THEN d.driverid END) AS peter_winners,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.forename = 'John' THEN d.driverid END) AS john_winners
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE r.positionorder = 1

WITH italian AS (
    SELECT c.constructorid,
           c.name,
           c.url,
           COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors c
    LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr
           ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'

),
ranked AS (

SELECT name,

       url
FROM ranked

ORDER BY rnk, name

WITH q3_times AS (

fastest AS (

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality

JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = t.driverid

SELECT r.year, COUNT(*) AS total_pit_stops

WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013

  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 1995

SELECT k.nationality,

      AND r.rank = 1
GROUP BY k.nationality

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid)
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN status s ON s.statusid = res.statusid
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident'

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
       ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_time_ms,
       r.name AS race_name,
       c.name AS circuit_name,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM pitstops ps

  )

WITH winners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, d.nationality
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON r.driverid = d.driverid
    WHERE r.position = 1
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM winners
    ORDER BY dob ASC, (forename || ' ' || surname) ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT ra.name AS race_name, ra.date AS race_date

    JOIN oldest o ON o.driverid = r.driverid
    WHERE r.position = 1
    ORDER BY ra.date ASC, ra.name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
starts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_started

)
SELECT o.forename || ' ' || o.surname AS full_name,
       o.nationality,
       fw.race_name,
       fw.race_date,
       s.races_started
FROM oldest o
CROSS JOIN first_win fw
CROSS JOIN starts s

WITH q3_times AS (

         + split_part(q.q3, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000) AS ms

      AND q.q3 <> ''

SELECT number

WITH race AS (

    WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q2times AS (

           q.driverid,
           q.constructorid,

            + split_part(q.q2, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000) AS q2ms

),
ranked AS (

SELECT d.forename,

JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorid = rk.constructorid

WITH q2_2017 AS (
    SELECT d.surname, r.name AS race_name, q.q2
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
    JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''

fastest AS (

SELECT t.surname, t.race_name

WITH q3_times AS (
    SELECT d.code,
           q.q3,
           (split_part(q.q3, ':', 1)::numeric * 60000
            + split_part(q.q3, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000) AS q3_ms
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
    JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid

)
SELECT code, q3

SELECT DISTINCT d.code
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid

WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'

WITH element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '-'
    GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element
FROM element_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM element_counts)

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
    SELECT s.molecule_id,
           COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM single_bond_molecules s
    LEFT JOIN atom a
           ON a.molecule_id = s.molecule_id
          AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY s.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count)::numeric, 4) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_counts

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
     FROM atom a
     WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'i'
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM connected c
           JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
           WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
             AND (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
       )) AS iodine_atoms_with_single_bond,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
     FROM atom a
     WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 's'
       AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM connected c
           JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
           WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
             AND (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
       )) AS sulfur_atoms_with_single_bond

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS patient_count
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN DATE '1981-01-01' AND DATE '1986-12-31'
  AND l.plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND l."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0', '')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.date, p.birthday)) < 50

SELECT b.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM atom a
            WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
              AND lower(a.element) = 'f'
        )
    ) / COUNT(*),
    2

FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (

    FROM connected c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id

)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (

    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
)
AND molecule_id IN (

    FROM atom
    WHERE LOWER(element) IN ('p', 'br')

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    4
) AS chlorine_percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM single_bond_molecules)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
       m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label

WITH classified AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM bond b
                WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
                  AND b.bond_type <> '-'
            ) THEN 'other'
            ELSE 'all_single'
        END AS bond_group
    FROM molecule m
)
SELECT
    bond_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1
             WHEN label = '-' THEN -1
             ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM classified
GROUP BY bond_group

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
       COUNT(b.bond_id) FILTER (WHERE b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS multiple_bond_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1
  ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2
  ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_counts AS (
    SELECT pa.element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_cnt
    FROM plus_atoms pa
    WHERE pa.atom_id IN (
        SELECT atom_id FROM connected
        UNION
        SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
    )
    GROUP BY pa.element
),
top_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM bonded_counts
    WHERE bonded_cnt = (SELECT MAX(bonded_cnt) FROM bonded_counts)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms FROM plus_atoms
)
SELECT pa.element,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / t.total_atoms, 2) AS percentage
FROM plus_atoms pa
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE pa.element IN (SELECT element FROM top_elements)
GROUP BY pa.element, t.total_atoms

SELECT b.bond_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1
    ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2
    ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND LOWER(a1.element) = 'c'
  AND LOWER(a2.element) = 'c'
GROUP BY b.bond_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id2) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

  AND m.label = '+'

WITH unique_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
   AND a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM unique_elements)

SELECT COUNT(c.atom_id2) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom AS a
INNER JOIN connected AS c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'

SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (

    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE EXISTS (

    FROM atom a

)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1

    JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
)

SELECT ROUND(
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397')::numeric
    / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397'),
    2
)

WITH y_molecule AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE LOWER(element) = 'y'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM y_molecule)
  AND (LOWER(a1.element) = 'h' OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'h')

WITH rare_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
)
SELECT a.molecule_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN rare_elements r
  ON r.element = a.element
JOIN connected c
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
ORDER BY a.molecule_id

SELECT
    CASE WHEN a1.element = 'c' THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  AND ((a1.element = 'c') <> (a2.element = 'c'))
GROUP BY 1

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM atom a
      WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        AND LOWER(a.element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond b
      WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        AND b.bond_type <> '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

WITH carbon_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE LOWER(element) = 'c'
),
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
           SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbon,
           SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorine
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
           SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_carbon_bonds
    FROM bond b
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected c
        JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
        WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id
          AND 'c' IN (LOWER(a1.element), LOWER(a2.element))
    )
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
inventory AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id,
           m.label,
           ac.num_atoms,
           COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
           ac.num_carbon,
           COALESCE(ac.num_chlorine, 0) AS num_chlorine,
           COALESCE(cbc.num_carbon_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_bonds,
           COALESCE(bc.num_multiple, 0) AS num_multiple_bonds
    FROM carbon_molecules cm
    JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN carbon_bond_counts cbc ON cbc.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
)
SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (
           ORDER BY num_carbon_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
       ) AS rank,
       molecule_id,
       label,
       num_atoms,
       num_bonds,
       num_carbon,
       num_chlorine,
       num_carbon_bonds,
       num_multiple_bonds
FROM inventory
ORDER BY num_carbon_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC

WITH mb AS (
    SELECT bond_id, bond_type
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
      AND bond_type IN ('-', '=')
),
bc AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM mb
    GROUP BY bond_type
),
ep AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mb.bond_type,
           LEAST(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,
           GREATEST(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2
    FROM mb
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = mb.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
pc AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM ep
    GROUP BY bond_type
)
SELECT bc.bond_type AS bond_symbol,
       bc.bond_count AS bond_count,
       pc.pair_count AS element_pair_count,
       m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bc
JOIN pc ON pc.bond_type = bc.bond_type
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bc.bond_count DESC, bc.bond_type ASC

WITH elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT element
    FROM atom
),
saturated_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom a
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected c
        WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected c
        JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
        WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
          AND b.bond_type IS DISTINCT FROM '-'
    )
)
SELECT e.element,
       COUNT(s.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM elements e
LEFT JOIN saturated_atoms s ON s.element = e.element
GROUP BY e.element
ORDER BY e.element

SELECT a.element,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND (
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected c WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected c WHERE c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element

WITH triple_elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.element
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)
SELECT a.element,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.element IN (SELECT element FROM triple_elements)
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.admission
    FROM patient p
    WHERE p.sex = 'F'
      AND p.birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' - INTERVAL '50 years'
      AND p.admission IN ('+', '-')
),
patient_flags AS (
    SELECT e.id,
           e.admission,
           BOOL_OR(
               CASE
                   WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                        THEN CASE WHEN l.rnp::numeric >= 4 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
                   ELSE FALSE
               END
           ) AS has_elevated_rnp
    FROM eligible e
    LEFT JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = e.id
    GROUP BY e.id, e.admission
)
SELECT CASE pf.admission
           WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
           WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
       END AS care_setting,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pf.has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_with_elevated_anti_rnp,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT pf.has_elevated_rnp) AS patients_without_elevated_anti_rnp
FROM patient_flags pf
GROUP BY pf.admission
ORDER BY care_setting
